name: Butorphanol
summary: Butorphanol is a morphinan-type synthetic agonist–antagonist opioid analgesic developed by Bristol-Myers. Butorphanol is most closely structurally related to levorphanol. Butorphanol is available as the tartrate salt in injectable, tablet, and intranasal spray formulations. The tablet form is only used in dogs, cats and horses due to low bioavailability in humans.

pharmacology.text: Butorphanol exhibits partial agonist and antagonist activity at the μ-opioid receptor, as well as partial agonist activity at the κ-opioid receptor (Ki = 2.5 nM; EC50 = 57 nM; Emax = 57%). Stimulation of these receptors on central nervous system neurons causes an intracellular inhibition of adenylate cyclase, closing of influx membrane calcium channels, and opening of membrane potassium channels.
pharmacology.kind: μ-Opioid receptor agonist–antagonist; κ-Opioid receptor agonist; Opioid analgesic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: The most common indication for butorphanol is management of migraine using the intranasal spray formulation. It may also be used parenterally for management of moderate-to-severe pain, as a supplement for balanced general anesthesia, and management of pain during labor. Butorphanol is also quite effective at reducing post-operative shivering (owing to its kappa agonist activity). Butorphanol is more effective in reducing pain in women than in men.

zhOther: 布托啡諾, 美妥芬诺
summaryZh: 布托啡諾（INN：英語：Butorphanol）是一種合成的嗎啡喃類激動劑－拮抗劑型類阿片鎮痛藥，由百時美施貴寶開發。化學結構與左啡諾最接近。布托啡諾以酒石酸鹽形式供應，有注射劑、錠劑及鼻噴劑等劑型。其中錠劑僅用於狗、貓及馬，因為口服時在人體的生物利用度極低。

sideEffects.en: It commonly causes drowsiness, dizziness, nausea and sweating, and its kappa activity can cause unpleasant mental effects, including feeling detached, dysphoria and hallucinations. Given to someone dependent on other opioids, it can bring on withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 它常造成嗜睡、頭暈、噁心與出汗，而它的 kappa 作用可能引起不適的精神反應，包括脫離感、情緒惡劣與幻覺。對已依賴其他鴉片類者使用，可能引發戒斷。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它常造成嗜睡、头晕、恶心与出汗，而它的 kappa 作用可能引起不适的精神反应，包括脱离感、情绪恶劣与幻觉。对已依赖其他鸦片类者使用，可能引发戒断。

fact.en: It is given as a nasal spray for migraine and is also widely used by vets on horses, cats and dogs. It pushes on the kappa opioid receptor while partly blocking the mu receptor.
fact.zh: 美妥芬諾以鼻噴劑形式用於偏頭痛，獸醫也廣泛用於馬、貓與狗。它推動 kappa 鴉片受體，同時部分阻斷 μ 受體。
fact.zhHans: 美妥芬诺以鼻喷剂形式用于偏头痛，兽医也广泛用于马、猫与狗。它推动 kappa 鸦片受体，同时部分阻断 μ 受体。
